data.reason: A plan to amend rather than a defect. The triage's slice_files check names harness/secrets.py as changed and belonging to no slice, and it is right: F4's fix needed it. The rule the registry gained, harness/no-live-marketplace-host, is proven by a fixture whose connector test fetches a live Bol URL, and secrets.marketplace_hosts walks every tracked file in the tree, so without one line telling it to skip rules/fixtures/ the fixture fails the repository's own lint. The exclusion belongs in that one function, because moving it out would restate one rule in the three callers that ask the question. Slice 2 is the slice that owns the ground rules and their fixtures, so the file is named there, with a changes entry saying what it is for. No reviewer has read this diff: the triage passed every criterion and this check is the only one it failed.
